name: status
description: Connection state of the Echo memory server and EchoDebug agent, plus the attached target.

name: list_processes
description: List processes running on the local machine (pid, name, path).

name: attach
description: Attach Echo to a process by executable name or pid. Required before any memory tool.

name: detach
description: Detach from the currently attached process.

name: is_alive
description: Check whether the attached process is still running.

name: list_modules
description: List loaded modules (name, base, size) of the attached process.

name: read_memory
description: Read raw bytes. Returns lowercase hex in 'data'. Max 1 MiB.

name: read_memory_batch
description: Read several small ranges in one round trip. Each entry is at most 64 KiB.

name: write_memory
description: Write bytes (lowercase hex, no prefix) to an address in the attached process. Refuses to write into unmapped memory unless force=true; the reply includes the region flags.

name: query_region
description: Describe the memory region that contains an address (base, size, present, writable, executable).

name: disassemble
description: Disassemble code at an address (x86-64 by default). size 0 lets the backend pick the function extent. arch 'arm64' decodes AArch64 (Linux arm64 / Windows-on-ARM modules); the Linux local backend picks it from the module's ELF header by itself.

arch.description: instruction set; default x86-64 (local backend: the module's)

name: enumerate_functions
description: Enumerate functions of a module (address, size).

name: signature_scan
description: Scan a module for an IDA-style byte pattern ('48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?').

name: signature_scan_masked
description: Scan a module for a masked byte pattern (hex bytes plus an x/? mask).

name: string_scan
description: Find occurrences of an ASCII string inside a module.

name: resolve_relative
description: Resolve a RIP-relative target: address + inst_size + int32 at (address + offset).

name: rtti_resolve
description: Resolve the MSVC RTTI class name of an object (address of the object, i.e. of its vtable pointer).

name: rtti_resolve_batch
description: Resolve RTTI class names for several objects at once.

name: memory_regions
description: Walk the virtual address space and list regions with protection flags.

name: pointer_chain
description: Follow a pointer chain: addr = *addr + offset per level.

name: value_scan_first
description: Start a Cheat Engine style value scan.

name: value_scan_next
description: Narrow the current value scan.

name: value_scan_results
description: Page through current value scan candidates.

name: value_scan_clear
description: Discard the current value scan state.

name: pointer_scan
description: Find static pointer paths (module+offset -> offsets...) that lead to a target address.

name: emulate
description: Emulate x86-64 code (or AArch64 with arch 'arm64' on the Linux local backend: x0-x30/sp/pc/nzcv registers, 'v' for v0-v31) with Unicorn against the attached process memory (never modifies the process). Use 'write' to inject bytes before the run, 'read' to fetch bytes back after it, and 'mem_log' to see which addresses the code reads and writes. Options: trace_regs, stubs, layers, on_unmapped, xmm (replies add reg_trace, api_calls, layers, faults, xmm; the Windows agent also returns ymm and the regions mapped during the run).

mem_log.description: Log every explicit memory read/write: rip, address, size, access, value before and (writes) after

trace_regs.description: per instruction, the GPRs that changed (reg_trace)

stubs.description: simulate common API calls (Windows: VirtualAlloc/Protect, GetProcAddress, GetModuleHandle, LoadLibrary, memcpy/memset/strlen, heap, timers, debugger checks; Linux: libc memcpy/memmove/memset/strlen/malloc/calloc/free/strcmp) and return to the caller (api_calls)

layers.description: report pages written and then executed (unpacking layers)

on_unmapped.description: zero: map a zero page on unmapped reads and continue (faults are listed)

arch.description: CPU; default x86-64 (local backend: the start address's module). arm64 takes x0-x30, fp, lr, sp, pc, nzcv in regs

v.description: arm64: v0..v31 -> up to 32 hex chars (little-endian); the reply then carries v0..v31

name: emu_start
description: Start an emulated-debugger session (Unicorn x86-64) at 'start': pages fault in from the attached process on demand and the process is never modified. With 'code' (hex) a blank emulator runs those bytes. Replaces any previous session. Returns registers, the next instructions and the stack. Options: trace_regs, stubs, layers, on_unmapped, xmm (replies add reg_trace, api_calls, layers, faults, xmm).

trace_regs.description: per instruction, the GPRs that changed (reg_trace)

stubs.description: simulate common API calls (Windows: VirtualAlloc/Protect, GetProcAddress, GetModuleHandle, LoadLibrary, memcpy/memset/strlen, heap, timers, debugger checks; Linux: libc memcpy/memmove/memset/strlen/malloc/calloc/free/strcmp) and return to the caller (api_calls)

layers.description: report pages written and then executed (unpacking layers)

on_unmapped.description: zero: map a zero page on unmapped reads and continue (faults are listed)

name: emu_step
description: Execute 'count' (default 1) instructions in the emulator session, stopping early at a breakpoint. Returns the new state and the stop reason (step, count, breakpoint, returned, fault, timeout).

name: emu_run
description: Run the emulator session until a breakpoint, the 'until' address, a return from the start function, a fault, max_insns or timeout_us (<= 5 s).

name: emu_break
description: Set (enabled true, default) or remove (enabled false) an emulator breakpoint; 'clear' removes all first.

condition.description: stop only when it holds, e.g. rax==0x10, rcx!=0, rdx<0x100, r8&1

name: emu_set
description: Edit the emulator session: registers ('regs': name -> 0x value) and memory ('write': [{address, data hex}]). Only emulator memory changes, never the process.

name: emu_read
description: Read emulator memory (pages the session has not touched read through to the process).

name: emu_state
description: Registers, next instructions, stack, breakpoints and instruction count of the emulator session.

name: emu_close
description: End the emulator session.

name: freeze_value
description: Continuously rewrite a value at an address (the agent re-writes it 20 times a second). Modes: set (write data), add (value += step each second), clamp (keep within min..max; needs value_type). Group entries to switch them together with freeze_group.

name: list_frozen
description: List the addresses the agent is currently freezing.

name: dump_module
description: Dump a module (default main executable) to Echo's scripts/dmp folder.

name: resolve_export
description: Resolve one export of a loaded module (module!name -> address).

name: peb_walk
description: Walk PEB->Ldr->InLoadOrderModuleList in the attached process via a process-backed Unicorn emulator; returns base/entry/size/full name per module.

name: list_threads
description: Threads of the attached process: tid, name, state (and wait reason), priority, CPU time, start address resolved to module+offset / symbol, TEB address (Windows) or TLS base (Linux fs_base), and registers. stacks:true adds an unwound call stack per thread. Registers are read by stopping each thread for a moment (ptrace interrupt / SuspendThread) and resuming it; nothing is written. Local Linux backend, or Windows without Echo (Echo has no thread APIs).

stacks.description: Unwind every thread's call stack (default false)

registers.description: Read registers (default true); false lists threads without stopping them

pid.description: Windows without Echo: process id (default the attached target)

name: thread_stack
description: Call stack of one thread: x64 unwinding with .pdata/UNWIND_INFO (PE) or .eh_frame CFI (ELF), falling back to the frame-pointer chain and a stack scan (those frames are marked guessed). Each frame: address, stack pointer, module+offset, nearest symbol (exports / ELF symbols), method. The thread is stopped only while its registers and stack are read.

tid.description: Thread id (Linux default: the main thread)

pid.description: Windows without Echo: process id (default the attached target)

name: list_handles
description: Open handles of the attached process: on Linux the entries of /proc/PID/fd (fd, kind, target, position, open flags); on Windows without Echo the process's entries of SystemExtendedHandleInformation with object type names, access masks and names of files, keys and named objects.

pid.description: Windows without Echo: process id (default the attached target)

name: tls_callbacks
description: TLS callbacks of a PE module from its TLS directory (static analysis of the loaded image; every backend): address, module+offset, section, whether it lies in executable code, nearest name. They run before the entry point and on every thread attach/detach. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: exception_handlers
description: Structured exception handlers of a PE module from .pdata + UNWIND_INFO: every function with a language handler (EHANDLER / UHANDLER), the handler routine (resolved through exports, user names and import thunks: __C_specific_handler, __CxxFrameHandler3/4, GCC), and for C handlers the scope table (__try ranges, __except filter and target, __finally blocks). Vectored handlers are not enumerable without undocumented ntdll internals and are not listed. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: reopen_native_socket
description: Re-open Echo's native memory socket towards the relay (used after a relay restart).

name: watch_add
description: Watch an address: the agent samples it 10x/s and streams watch_event broadcasts when the bytes change. size is 1..16 bytes (default 4). Up to 256 bytes; with value_type the events carry decoded old/new values, condition filters them (eq/ne/gt/lt value, delta = change of at least value); watch_list shows hits and recent history.

alert.description: Echo alert on each hit (Windows agent)

name: watch_remove
description: Stop watching an address.

name: list_watched
description: List watched addresses with their last sampled bytes.

name: read_typed
description: Read a decoded value: u8..u64, i8..i64, f32, f64 (value + raw hex), string, wstring, bytes (hex; length 1..4096).

name: region_stats
description: Aggregate the target's memory regions by protection: counts and bytes for present/writable/executable, rw vs rx split.

name: alert_add
description: Add a conditional alert on an address (Windows agent): the agent checks it 50x/s and, when the condition becomes true, logs it in Echo's console and broadcasts alert_event with old/new bytes and a memory snapshot around the address (the app logs it to Output).

value.description: Compare target (not for 'changed'); hex for bytes

size.description: bytes/string/wstring + changed: bytes to compare (1..256, default 16)

once.description: Remove the alert after it fires once (default false = repeating)

snapshot.description: Bytes captured around the address when it fires (0..1024, default 64)

name: alert_remove
description: Remove a conditional alert by id.

name: alert_list
description: List conditional alerts with their condition, fire count and last sampled bytes.

name: ui_pe_info
description: PE headers, sections, data directories, imports, exports, per-section entropy and packer verdict of a module (parsed in the app). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_strings
description: ASCII and UTF-16 strings of a module with their addresses; optional regex filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_xrefs_to
description: Code references (call/jmp/jcc/RIP-relative) to an address inside a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_xref_index
description: The most-referenced addresses of a module (whole reference graph indexed in one pass). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_crypto_scan
description: Known crypto constant tables (AES, SHA-256, MD5, CRC-32, Blowfish, ChaCha, TEA, Base64…) in a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_code_caves
description: Padding runs (0xCC/0x90/0x00) inside executable sections that can hold a stub. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_antidebug_scan
description: Anti-debug checks in a module: INT 2D, VMCALL, PEB/TEB reads, timing checks, detection APIs, debugger window names. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_triage_imports
description: Imports that deserve a second look (memory tampering, injection, anti-analysis), ranked by risk. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_make_signature
description: Build a unique IDA-style signature for the code at an address (wildcards rel32/disp32, grows until unique). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_dotnet_types
description: .NET (ECMA-335) types, methods and fields of a managed module; optional name filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_flirt_match
description: Match the FLIRT signature file loaded in the app against a module. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_rtti_classes
description: MSVC RTTI classes of a module with base classes and vftables; optional name filter. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_snapshot_diff
description: Read a memory window, wait delay_ms, read it again and list the bytes that changed. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_cfg
description: Control-flow graph of the function at an address: basic blocks, terminators and taken/fall-through/switch-case edges. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

with_text.description: include the instructions of each block

name: ui_assemble
description: Assemble x86-64 instructions at an address (nop, ret, int3, jmp/call/jcc to an address, push/pop, mov, add/sub/and/or/xor/cmp/test, inc/dec, db). Returns the bytes; does not write them. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_search_code
description: Search the disassembly of a module's executable sections with a regex over the instruction text (e.g. 'cmp .*0x539'). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_jump_table
description: Recover the switch jump table behind an indirect jmp (MSVC rva tables, GCC relative tables, absolute pointer tables). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_functions
description: Function bounds from the module's x64 exception directory (.pdata). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_find_memory
description: Search process memory forward (or backward) from an address for bytes (IDA-style with ??), text, UTF-16 or a typed value. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

mode.description: hex ascii utf16 i8 u8 i16 u16 i32 u32 i64 u64 f32 f64

name: ui_group_scan
description: Group scan: find places where several values sit at fixed offsets, e.g. 'i32:100; +4 f32:1.5; +8 i32:*'. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_inspect
description: Every interpretation of the bytes at an address (ints, floats, pointer, time, strings) in both byte orders, plus the bytes in a copy format (spaced, hex, c, rust, python, escaped, base64, ida). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_yara_scan
description: Run YARA rules (text, hex with wildcards/jumps/alternatives, regex; and/or/not, of-sets, counts, offsets, filesize, uintXX) over a module, every module (module '*'), or a memory range (address + size). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_sig_health
description: Scan every signature in the app's catalog and report which no longer match exactly once. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_flirt_pat
description: Generate IDA FLIRT .pat lines for a module's functions (names from the app's names; relocated operands wildcarded). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_pe_details
description: Rich header (with checksum check), TLS callbacks, relocation summary, debug directory (PDB name, GUID, age, symbol key) and imphash of a module; signature:true also reads the file and checks its Authenticode digest. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_resources
description: Resources of a module: version info, manifest, string tables, dialogs, icon count, resource count. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_load_symbols
description: Load the module's PDB by its CodeView GUID/age: the symbol path, the image's folder and the cache first, then (network access) download it from the configured symbol servers (default msdl.microsoft.com; .pd_ cabinets are expanded) into the cache's <pdb>/<GUID><age>/<pdb> layout. Every view then names its functions and data (prototypes feed the pseudocode, file:line the disassembly). Reports the GUID/age match. download:false stays offline; apply_names also copies the names into the app's names list (exported with the session). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

apply_names.description: copy the symbol names into the names list

overwrite.description: with apply_names: replace names the user already set

download.description: ask the symbol servers when no local copy matches (default true)

allow_mismatch.description: load a PDB of another build when that is all there is

name: ui_pdb_symbols
description: Search the loaded PDB of a module: functions (with code size and prototype: return type, parameter names and types) and data symbols (with type and size). Loads a local copy first if needed (no network). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

filter.description: substring of the name or decorated name

name: ui_pdb_types
description: List the structs, classes, unions, enums and typedefs in a module's PDB (index, kind, size, member count). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_pdb_type
description: Layout of one PDB type: every field with offset, size, C type, bitfield position/width, the struct/enum it refers to, enum values, the types it embeds by value, and a C declaration. A typedef or pointer resolves to what it names. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

index.description: type index instead of a name

name: ui_import_pdb_type
description: Add a PDB type to the app's Structs catalog (embedded structs flattened as a.b, float triples as vec3, bitfields share their storage field); nested:true (default) also adds every struct it embeds. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_pdb_lookup
description: Symbolize an address with the loaded PDBs: module!function+offset, the function's start, size and prototype, and the source file:line. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_il
description: CIL disassembly of .NET methods matching a 'Type::Method' substring (or a token). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_user_strings
description: .NET user strings (#US) with the methods that ldstr each one. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_find_oep
description: Emulate a packed module from its entry point and propose original entry points (code the stub wrote, or the jump into another section). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_rebuild_imports
description: Recover the import table of an unpacked module from its live IAT (pointers into other modules' exports). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_batch_decrypt
description: Run a string-decryption routine at every call site in the emulator and return the strings each call wrote. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_binary_diff
description: Diff the live module against an older build (a PE file path on this machine): changed, added and removed functions. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

module.description: Module name; default the main executable

name: ui_guess_struct
description: Guess a struct layout from the live bytes at an address (vtable/function/data pointers, strings, vectors, floats, ints); save:true adds it to the app's type catalog. Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: ui_export_struct
description: Export a type from the app's catalog as C++, C, IDAPython, Ghidra script, Binary Ninja script or ReClass.NET XML (format: cpp c ida ghidra binja reclass). Runs in the EchoDebug app window.

name: hook_scan
description: Hook / tamper scan of a module (module '*' = every module): executable code that differs from the file on disk (rebased with its relocations), exports whose first instruction jumps out of the module (inline hooks), and IAT slots pointing at unbacked memory ('all': also imports resolved into another module). PE modules (app window).

file.description: compare with the file on disk (default true)

name: module_monitor
description: Start (enabled true, default) or stop polling the module list; loads and unloads become module_loaded / module_unloaded events (MCP notifications) and a timeline.

name: module_timeline
description: Module load/unload events seen by the module monitor (last 500).

name: page_monitor
description: Watch a memory range for changes: every 4 KiB page is hashed each tick and changed pages are reported as page_changed events (self-modifying code, unpacking, patches). enabled false stops it. 64 MiB in total.

name: page_monitor_list
description: Watched ranges with their change counts.

name: sig_scan_batch
description: Scan many IDA patterns in one request (up to 512); per pattern the hit count and up to max_hits addresses.

name: disasm_function
description: Disassemble a function from its start to the first return in one read.

name: read_fields
description: Read many typed fields of one structure from a single memory snapshot: fields [{offset, type: u8..u64 | i8..i64 | f32 | f64 | ptr}].

name: engine_detect
description: Guess the game engine from the loaded modules (unreal, unity-il2cpp, source).

name: unreal_objects
description: Unreal Engine 4.23+/5: locate GNames (FNamePool) and GObjects (FUObjectArray) and list objects with class and full name. Optional 'names'/'objects' addresses override the search; 'filter' matches names, 'class' an exact class (e.g. Class, ScriptStruct, Function).

name: unreal_sdk
description: Unreal Engine: generate a C++ SDK header (classes/structs with property offsets, sizes and padding) for classes matching 'filter' (at most 'max', default 200).

name: il2cpp_dump
description: Unity IL2CPP: parse global-metadata.dat (v24-31; from 'metadata_path' or found in memory) and list types and methods with GameAssembly RVAs. 'filter' matches Namespace.Type; 'dump_cs' adds dump.cs text.

name: source_netvars
description: Source engine: walk client.dll's ClientClass list and RecvTables. Without 'table': classes and their tables; with 'table' (e.g. DT_BasePlayer): every netvar with its offset, nested tables resolved. 'text' adds a netvars.txt dump.

name: lift_block
description: Lift straight-line code at an address (until a branch or return) to expressions: per-instruction effects, final register and memory formulas (simplified, including MBA), dead instructions, and the closing branch with its condition (constant = opaque predicate).

name: lift_trace
description: Deobfuscate an execution: emulate from 'start' (or take 'trace'), execute the path symbolically, keep only instructions that affect the final state (junk, dead stores and stack noise removed), simplify every formula, and list branch conditions and opaque predicates.

start.description: emulate from here when no 'trace' is given

trace.description: instruction addresses in execution order (e.g. an emulate trace)

name: devirt
description: Devirtualization aid: on an emulated (or given) trace, find the VM dispatcher, split the run into handler executions, lift each distinct handler to its register/memory effects, guess the VIP register and return the virtual instruction stream (handler ids in order).

start.description: emulate from here when no 'trace' is given

trace.description: instruction addresses in execution order (e.g. an emulate trace)

name: trace_record
description: Record a time-travel trace: every instruction with its register changes and memory reads/writes (old and new bytes). source 'emu' records the Emu Debugger session (pass 'start' plus optional 'code'/'regs' to start one); source 'ptrace' (Linux) single-steps a real thread of the attached process (dbg_attach first; 'tid' picks the thread). Stops at max_steps (default 10000), 'until' (an address), max_mb (default 64) or trace_cancel. Saved to disk; returns the trace summary (trace_id). Gated like writes: ptrace runs the real thread.

keyframe.description: full register file every K steps (default 256)

start.description: emu: start a new session here first

code.description: emu: hex bytes for a blank emulator

name: trace_info
description: Summary of a recorded trace (steps, source, stop reason, unique pcs, reads/writes, initial and final registers); without 'trace' the current one, or the list of saved traces when there is none.

name: trace_query
description: Query a recorded trace at position 'pos' (0..steps; the state before step pos, default the end). kind: last_write (when did address..+size last change before pos; changed_only default true), writes_to / reads_of (every access to the range), executions_of (steps that ran an address), seek (next/previous execution of an address from pos, direction forward|back), reg_at (all registers or 'reg'), mem_at (memory reconstructed at pos, ?? = never touched), reg_series (a register over time), step / steps (instruction detail / listing), taint (where did 'reg' or address+size come from: walks back through mov/arith dataflow), touched (ranges the trace accessed).

name: freeze_group
description: Pause (enabled false) or resume every freeze in a group.

name: emu_watch
description: Emulator session memory watchpoint: stop when the range is read and/or written (access r, w, rw); clear removes all.

name: emu_snapshot
description: Save the emulator session (registers, xmm and all emulator memory) under a name, to go back with emu_restore.

name: emu_restore
description: Restore a saved emulator session snapshot (step back in time).

name: hash_pages
description: FNV-1a hash of every 4 KiB page in the ranges, computed by the backend (16 hex digits per page, unreadable = 0).

name: mem_snapshot
description: Keep a copy of a range (address+size, or a whole module; up to 16 MiB) in the backend for mem_diff.

name: mem_diff
description: Changed ranges since mem_snapshot (old/new bytes); update true makes the current contents the new baseline.

name: mem_snapshot_list
description: Snapshots kept by the backend.

name: ptr_save
description: Save the last pointer_scan results as a named pointer map (on disk, survives restarts).

name: ptr_compare
description: Paths present in every listed pointer map ('@last' = the last scan): run a scan after each game restart, save it, then compare to keep only stable paths.

name: find_instances
description: Every object whose vtable pointer equals the given vtable (8-aligned qwords in writable memory), with the class name from RTTI.

name: rtti_name
description: Class name of a vtable (or of an object with object=true) from MSVC RTTI (Windows) or Itanium type_info (Linux).

name: xref_scan
description: References to an address, scanned in the backend: rel32 calls/jumps, RIP-relative operands and (pointers true) absolute 8-byte pointers; module restricts the range.

name: cancel_job
description: Cancel the running long job (scan, pointer scan, emulation).

name: backend_stats
description: Per-verb call counts and handler time in the backend, the running job, queued events.

name: write_journal
description: Recent writes and freezes with their old and new bytes (persisted by the backend); clear true empties it.

name: agent_config
description: Windows agent settings saved to echodebug/agent.json: relay port (used on the next load), auto_attach process name, alerts.

name: list_names
description: List the user's address names from the EchoDebug app window.

name: set_name
description: Name an address in the EchoDebug app window (shown in the disassembly and exports). An empty name removes it.

name: list_comments
description: List the user's address comments from the EchoDebug app window.

name: set_comment
description: Set the comment of an address in the EchoDebug app window. An empty comment removes it.

name: list_patches
description: List the patch journal from the EchoDebug app window: every write with the bytes it replaced and whether it was reverted.

name: revert_patch
description: Revert a journalled patch by id: the app window writes the original bytes back and marks the patch reverted.

name: list_signatures
description: List the signatures the user saved in the EchoDebug app window (name, module, IDA pattern, original address, last hit count).

name: sync_status
description: Live disassembler sync (IDA / Ghidra / Binary Ninja): connected tools with their modules, the module map, direction toggles, the last synced cursor and the recent sync log (names, comments, conflicts).

log_limit.description: Log entries to return, newest last (default 100, max 300)
